versions.changelog: Replaces direct-contact MCP quote submission with a read-only saved-plan handoff; buyers review and submit their own contact details on TempGuru form.

No user-facing changes in this release.

- No file changes detected; documentation and workflow remain unchanged.
- Functionality and guidance for agency partner inquiries are consistent with prior version.

**Partner onboarding workflow and compliance details improved for TempGuru agencies.**

- Clarifies this skill is only for staffing agencies (not job seekers or buyers).
- Adds structured guidance on using MCP tools to match agency coverage with TempGuru markets and roles.
- Outlines W-2 compliance as the partner baseline (workers’ comp, liability, payroll taxes, I-9).
- Establishes strict routing: partner inquiries go only to megan@tempguru.co or (904) 206-8953—never via request_quote.
- Provides a suggested inquiry email format and honest expectation setting about vetting and acceptance.
